verdict.rationale: The evidence contains only marketing-level transcription claims: 100+ languages, speaker identification, live transcription and multi-language mode. Nothing documents the underlying ASR models, how transcription works, accuracy figures or benchmarks, or known limitations. These are feature assertions, not the transparency documentation the story asks for.

support.subject: As a product manager, the vendor documents how transcription actually works and its quality (models, accuracy claims, known limits) rather than just saying "AI-powered"
